name: vertical-text
title: Vertical Text
description: Vertical writing (tategaki) with CSS writing modes: characters run top to bottom and columns right to left, whatever the page's reading order or writing direction, and the text stays real text. A column height wraps it into new columns; the reading, lettering or SFX face; Latin letters lying on their side or upright; an optional fine rule between columns like a manuscript sheet. Tcy sets a short number upright in one cell (tate-chu-yoko).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/vertical-text". Give it a height (prop or class) to wrap long text into several columns; without one a column is as tall as its text. The kit's fonts do not cover kanji: Japanese text falls back to the system's Japanese face.

meta.tagline: Text written top to bottom, columns right to left.
meta.usage:
import { Tcy, VerticalText } from "@/components/manga/vertical-text"

<VerticalText height="12rem">
  雨の夜、<Tcy>12</Tcy>時。
</VerticalText>

props.name: height
props.description: Column height (any CSS length). Text wraps into a new column on the left.

props.name: font
props.description: Reading face, lettering face or the SFX face.

props.name: upright
props.description: Latin letters stand upright instead of lying on their side.

props.name: ruled
props.description: A fine ink rule between columns.
